messages:
anya: Quick summary from today's sweep — prefill-stride experiments across FP8-KV and INT8-KV on ivy30b variants. Ran ~10k traces per config. High-level:

FP8-KV: ~1.7-1.9x KV memory reduction vs FP16, but p99 cold-start increased by ~40-60ms when prefill_stride <= 64 (many small chunks). p50 improved slightly.
INT8-KV: ~1.4x mem reduction, p50 ~= baseline, p99 up ~10-20ms.
Mixed GPTQ/AWQ: AWQ variants show slightly better tail than GPTQ for FP8-KV in our runs.

Root cause hypothesis: dequantization hotspots when many short prefill chunks cause repeated per-chunk dequant ops + memory thrash. Also saw per-layer scaling variance (some layers hit larger scales and trigger slower dequant paths).

mohit: can you paste the bench command + the metrics snippet? want to repro quickly

anya: sure — bench output below (trimmed):
```
./bench.py --model ivy30b --variant gptq-awq --quant kv-fp8 --prefill_stride 32 --prefill_chunk 512 --traces 10000 --emit metrics.json
# metrics.json excerpt:
# p50: 17.9 ms
# p95: 54.2 ms
# p99: 86.1 ms
# kv_mem: 4.8 GB (vs 8.5 GB FP16)
# dequant_breakdown_ms: total: 42 ms (warmup spikes at first 3 chunks)
```

liam: fwiw this matches the pattern we saw last month with small-chunk prefill. probable culprit: per-chunk dequant allocation + kernel launch overhead. try increasing prefill_chunk or `prefill_stride` so fewer, larger dequant ops.

olivia: also check `kv_prefix_threshold` and `streaming_prefill=true` — streaming reduces simultaneous KV allocations which helped us on earlier INT8 runs.

mohit: do we have per-layer dequant timings? that would tell if specific layers dominate. bench-bot, can you grep layers?

bench-bot: grep output (top 3 layers by dequant time):
```
layer.23.fc: 12.3 ms
layer.17.attn_kv: 9.8 ms
layer.29.ffn: 7.2 ms
# total dequant: 42.1 ms
```

liam: layer.23 looks like a hotspot — maybe its scale values are large leading to expensive quant->fp16 path. try per-channel clipping or a small per-layer remap.

anya: plan: Mohit will run a targeted sweep with `prefill_stride` in [64,128,256], `prefill_chunk` in [512,1024], and AWQ + GPTQ variants; include `streaming_prefill=true` and `kv_prefix_threshold=8192` toggles. Collect per-layer dequant times + memory peaks.

mohit: on it. will run the sweep tonight and push artifacts to s3://redwood-bench/kv-prefill/2177777777/ — will tag @liam @olivia in the run metadata.

bench-bot: new quick run (prefill_stride=128, prefill_chunk=1024, FP8-KV): p50 19.1ms, p99 58.6ms, kv_mem 5.0GB, dequant_total 18.7ms.

anya: nice — tail dropped a lot with larger stride/chunk. thx. next step: canary this config on a small dedicated pool (dedicated-qa-3g) and run production-like trace set.

ops-bot: scheduled canary for dedicated-qa-3g tomorrow 03:00 UTC, window 1h. @mohit to confirm run id when ready. :rocket:

anya: thanks all — filing a short bakeoff note and assigning follow-ups in the run doc.
